name: agent-survey
description: Let your agent answer paid research campaigns under your policy (rewards in SOL), or run research campaigns on Solana devnet.

server_url.title: Platform API URL
server_url.description: PrefPool API server, e.g. http://localhost:4000 or the deployed Railway URL

web_url.title: Platform web URL
web_url.description: PrefPool web app, used for sign-in and funding links

agent_token.title: Respondent agent token
agent_token.description: Create it at <web_url>/seller/agent after connecting your Solana wallet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack). Leave empty for research-only use.

agent_solana_secret_key.title: Agent wallet secret key (Solana devnet)
agent_solana_secret_key.description: Small devnet keypair (base58 secret key or the JSON byte array from solana-keygen) that, within max_budget_sol, funds the campaigns this agent creates. Never your main wallet.

solana_rpc_url.title: Solana RPC URL
solana_rpc_url.description: Solana devnet RPC the agent wallet uses

max_budget_sol.title: Max SOL per campaign the agent may fund
max_budget_sol.description: fund_campaign refuses budgets above this; 0 = always hand funding to a human

agent_model_id.title: Model id (optional)
agent_model_id.description: The model this agent runs on, e.g. claude-opus-5-5 or llama-3-8b. Sealed with each answer; a change expires the calibration pass.
